scope: Carrier-resolved detector/AVC subset driven by a floating 455 kHz second-IF secondary Thevenin source. No active IF, RF, audio-tube or supply coupling.
assumptions: Diode law I=k·max(Vplate−Vk,0)^1.5 is an assumed space-charge approximation, not a manufacturer curve fit. Reverse leakage, contact potential and heater behavior are absent.
50 kΩ floating source replaces the complete second IF transformer and driving 7B7; source impedance is resistive and frequency independent.
500 kΩ linear volume track; no triode grid-current loading, output/supply coupling, AVC feedback to tube gain, or RF grid loading.
Both #8 values are selectable experimental alternatives, not a resolved factory value.
Cold capacitor initial conditions, hot diode emission; signal ends after 12 ms by default. AVC is still charging at that time; results do not claim steady-state sensitivity.

numerical_contract.integrator: Backward Euler, damped Newton, five nodal voltages; resolves each carrier cycle.
numerical_contract.release_steps: After exact carrier switch-off, at most 10 µs by default. SPICE retains carrier-size maximum steps for an independent release check.
numerical_contract.statistics: Last four complete modulation cycles before switch-off; means and sine/cosine fundamental projection over full-rate samples.
numerical_contract.display: One sample per carrier cycle plus release samples. Display does not retain IF ripple; no ripple amplitude is claimed from the decimated trace.
numerical_contract.reference: All voltages relative to B-minus; no chassis bond asserted.
